notes: Sidebar lanes get color and a name — each lane tile is tinted with its project's own hue (a checkout and all its worktrees share one color, and the palette avoids the amber/green/blue/red the status language owns), and a lane chip in the top bar names the lane you're in when the sidebar is collapsed. Pick which agent gets the work — clicking a Pull Request or Jira row now opens a handoff picker of your agent panes instead of always handing to the current pane; each pane is labelled the way the sidebar names it (project, or project / worktree). Followed PRs say when they're over — a followed row that merges or closes shows a MERGED/CLOSED badge, drops the stale merge-status chip, and swaps its handoff from Review to Summarize.
